summary: Shortened the draft mainly by removing optional narration, a dispensable reaction exchange, secondary explanatory clauses in Tommy's account and several optional diary entries. All eight protected excerpts and every essential plot function remain, and the ending is intact. My estimated length is roughly 1,820–1,830 words; it has not been measured.
